reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduleAmount, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance; every worst-case consumer (forecast, schedule actions, posting, preview, API model) picks it up.

duplication.why: No new logic outside the one helper; the body actually gets simpler.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it.

scope.why: Helper body, its test table and comment updates at call sites only.

maintainability.why: A two-line rule in one function with a table-driven test is easy to own.
